script_text: Wake the body up a little. Nothing strenuous. Sit up, or stand, and let your spine lengthen. Roll your shoulders back — slowly, once. And again. Take a fuller breath than you have been taking, and let it out easily. If it feels right, stretch your arms out, or above you. Shake out your hands. Notice there is a little more warmth, a little more readiness, than there was a minute ago. Movement first. The rest tends to follow.
